summary: Defines an extension to the Extensible Provisioning Protocol that lets registrars ask a registry what fees and credits apply to billable actions and state the expected fees when issuing commands. It exists because new domain extensions and business models have made pricing more varied.

eli5.summary: Before buying something, you ask the shop its price and say what you expect to pay. This lets domain sellers do that with registries.

questions: how do epp clients query domain fees
what is the epp fee extension
